label: dcm2niix (reproin)
description: Convert reproin format DICOMs using dcm2niix.

fields.label: Strip dates
fields.help: Off matches reproinx.py: strip PII but keep AcquisitionDateTime and provenance demographics for participants.tsv. On strips dates too; age/sex may be unavailable.

fields.label: Save derivatives
fields.help: Keep dcm2niix's derivatives/ subtree (scouts, DERIVED images). Off = clean main tree only.

fields.label: Shift dates
fields.help: De-identify acquisition dates (BIDS RECOMMENDED): shift every subject's dates so its earliest scan lands on 1925-01-01, keeping time-of-day and intra-subject intervals. Removes provenance TSVs. Does not rename timestamp-based ses-YYYYMMDD... folders.
